description: This PHP source file defines the DetailedTimesheetModel class in the OrangeHRM system, which serializes detailed timesheet data into an array suitable for API responses. It includes properties, constructor, and a method to convert detailed timesheet objects into nested associative arrays with project, customer, activity, total duration, and date-specific entries.

classes.name: DetailedTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes DetailedTimesheet data into a structured array for API responses, including project, customer, activity, total duration, and date-specific details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DetailedTimesheetModel with a DetailedTimesheet object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the encapsulated DetailedTimesheet data into a nested associative array, organizing timesheet rows with detailed project, customer, activity, total duration, and individual date entries.
